name: Melco International Development Limited
summary: Melco International Development Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the leisure and entertainment business in Macau, the Philippines, and Cyprus. It operates in two segments, Casino and Hospitality, and Others. The company operates casinos and provides hospitality services and facilities through Melco Resorts.
